High-sensitivity quantitative detector platform: Minimum
seven fluorescence detectors: four broadband spectral detectors,
two red-shifted spectral detectors optimized for far-red/NIR
imaging, and one dedicated super-resolution detector.
Broadband and red-shifted channels shall use high-sensitivity
silicon-photomultiplier technology, such as SilVIR or a
functionally equivalent architecture, with photon-counting
detection, ultra-low noise, high signal-to-noise, linear
quantitative response, high dynamic range, absolute detected-
photon quantitation, and consistent sensitivity across
fluorescence channels. Routine acquisition shall not require
manual detector-voltage, gain, or offset adjustment. PMT or
GaAsP-PMT detectors are not equivalent unless they
demonstrate equivalent photon-counting rate, dynamic range,
quantitative linearity, spectral range, and noise performance.

substantially lower background noise than conventional GaAsP-
